reviews.comment: I loved Wang! He's such a nice guy and really tries to get to know his students. Attendance isn't mandatory but 100% recommend going. 2 tests and a cumulative final, you are allowed to bring cheat sheet. He curved all the tests because they are hard. Will show homework answers the day before its due.

Very friendly dude; Not the best lecturer. The students that succeed: study the homeworks before the exam!!! and know which equations to use. Cheat sheets help a lot. Definitely attend the class before an exam for an exam review. If he says "Is this important?!" during the review, then copy it down! TLDR: make your cheat sheet during review sesh.

Dr. Wang is a very sweet guy but I did not enjoy his lecture style. It was very hard to pay attention because he reads straight from the slides and examples are already worked out. I ended up just reading the slides on my own and was able to pass the exams. Overall, not the best prof but he does care about his students and cheat sheets help a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Wang is a great guy. The class isn't too hard as long as you do the homework. Three exams with similar problems to the lecture slides and homework problems. Honestly did not learn too much from lecture. Overall the class is good, you can get an A if you put a little effort into actually learning the material.

Dr. Wang may be my favorite professor I've taken at A&M! He's sweet, funny, and always loves to tell stories about his traveling and fishing trips. I never enjoyed going to class so much! His Aggie jokes always crack you up. If you have a chance to be in his class, don't hesitate to take it!

TAKE THIS PROF!! He is the kindest, mist caring professor ive ever had! I also suck at math and ended up with an A in this class! Tests come straight from the homework, so its very easy to study for. You also get cheat sheets on every exam!

Learned so much from your class. I think more professors should be like you. Someone who can teach, do research, inspires and makes his students laugh. Anyone who has the chance to take Dr Wang should!

Out of all the profs I've had so far, I've learned more, and enjoyed his lectures the most. He is by far one of the best professors in the TAMU Stats department. Dr. Wang truly cares for his students. He knows that teaching isn't about memorizing things that you will forget 1 year from now, but about the major concepts you'll remember forever.

Love Dr. Wang. Really amazing professor who cares about his students and is always willing to help. The homework can be pretty tedious, but it's really useful for the exams. Come to class for the Aggie jokes and pictures, you won't regret it. Happy birthday Dr. Wang!

Content of course can be significantly enhanced; often you do not see step by step process of deriving the final results; you just get a final numeric answer and have to spend hours to figure out what goes where.  Home works involve redundant big problems that are waste of time.  He does not discuss SAS/R as applied to survey design.
One of the best professors I've ever had.  Truly cares about his students, and spends the time to make sure you understand the material.

Professor Wang is the best professor I've ever had, including those in undergrad.  He is funny, extremely intelligent, and fair.  His best quality is that he cares A LOT about his students.  He wants everyone to succeed and will help you understand until you do.  Appropriately, he does expect a lot and his class is the most difficult I've taken.
